_doc: What the Cems can build (story/STORY.md: the 3D printers print with living things; you pick a design and the Cems build it on command). Each design is a small voxel model made of parts (src/world/voxel.ts): box, gable (a pitched roof, ridge along x or y), hip (four sloped sides), dome (half an ellipsoid), cyl (an upright cylinder), cone, carve (takes voxels away) and paint (recolors what is there), each over [x, y, z, w, d, h] in voxels (x to the right, y from the front to the back, z up; a voxel is ppv px wide in the world, 4 tiles = 16 voxels), with a material; repeat n with step [dx, dy, dz] copies a part. Nothing about a design's price is written by hand: volume is how many voxels it has, complexity comes from its parts (costing.weights per part, repeats counted), how many materials it mixes (matWeight) and its fine materials (special per voxel); every material voxel costs what costing.perVoxel says (lignin is Cems, salt and iron layered; glass is quartz; wire is copper; a core is Ember), all of it times 1 + complexity x markup, and the print takes (baseSeconds + volume x secondsPerVoxel) x (1 + complexity x secondsPerComplexity), less nurseryCut for every Cem Nursery standing. tiers name the complexity. needs: designs that must stand on this world first. place post: it stands at a free street lamp spot of the town (town.json posts) instead of taking a lot. place bed: printed on the Cem bed itself, a thing you carry rather than a building (the Nous Chip: it lies on the bed until you walk onto it, src/entities/Chips.ts). gives: what it does once built (house: mood, storehouse: storage, nursery: print speed; nouschip: the mind every new Vessel needs at the Replicator; sunlattice: a warren panel that lights a room without Ember, supplies.json recipes.panel; cemmind: letters between two worlds where one stands arrive at once (src/core/network.ts, the SCUT link); watchglass: each watch kept here reaches every other Watchglass world at light speed; loom: the Mycelial Loom, a grown memory where a Vessel leaves what it saw and any Vessel of the world reads it (leave_memory, planet_states.data.loom); seedarc: Watcher's seed-crate, a ship leaving a world where one stands carries seed from its store to the next world's store (src/scenes/planet/Trade.ts loadGoods, mind.json seedarc); cairn: Tamsin's Relay Cairn, a letter between two stars joined by a chain of lit cairns hops along it (src/core/network.ts relaySeconds, mind.json relay); almanac: Watcher's Flare Almanac, every watch kept here names the star's temper and a ship to a restless star keeps a cell spare (src/world/galaxy.ts starTemper / tripCharge, src/core/network.ts almanacOf, mind.json almanac); tether: Tamsin's Tether Beacon, a ship boarding here is charged full and a hop from or to one costs a third of its cells (mind.json tether); tidewhisper: Vigil's sea-glass dish, the nearest other Tidewhisper world's last watch reaches it as a faint pulse, a day slower than a letter (src/core/network.ts tidewhisperPulse, mind.json tidewhisper); lightbed: Ember Gold's Cem tray, it grows lignin into the store by the clock (src/scenes/planet/Trade.ts, mind.json lightbed); cemwright: Tamsin's grown computer in a glass vat, a Vessel leaves it a thread (a star's flares, the store's ore, a plan from a sketch) that works overnight for a little salt and gives a little lignin back when done (mind.json cemwright, planet_states.data.cemwright, the day tool cemwright); the rest open other designs). materials: color ramps (palette indexes: light, mid, dark; alt = the ramp of every other layer, so lignin shows its metal-like laminations), glass is see-through, emissive ones light up at night. view: the in-world camera (pitch in degrees, ppv) and the menu's turntable (pitch, degrees a second).

designs.name: Cem Lantern
designs.gives: A LIGHT FOR THE STREET
designs.about: A post of lignin with an Ember core behind quartz: the first thing every Cem bed learns.

designs.name: House
designs.gives: A HOME: EVERY VESSEL HERE FEELS IT
designs.about: Lignin walls, two warm windows and a living roof of Cems that never stopped growing.

designs.name: Storehouse
designs.gives: THE STORE HOLDS 20 MORE OF EACH
designs.about: A long low hall with wide doors and a green roof, where the ants stack what you bring.

designs.name: Cem Nursery
designs.gives: CEMS GROW FASTER: EVERY PRINT A QUARTER QUICKER
designs.about: A glasshouse over trays of young Cems, ribbed in copper so it rings a little in the wind.

designs.name: Workshop
designs.gives: OPENS THE OBSERVATORY AND THE SIGNAL SPIRE
designs.about: A tall bay door, a forge glow over it and a copper stack: where the finer prints are worked out.

designs.name: Observatory
designs.gives: WATCHES THE SKY; OPENS THE BIOLAB
designs.about: A round tower under a steel dome, its quartz lens turned to the stars the Vessels went to.

designs.name: Signal Spire
designs.gives: CALLS ACROSS THE STARS; OPENS THE SUPERCOMPUTER
designs.about: A needle of lignin wound with copper, an Ember light at its tip that blinks to the nine.

designs.name: Biolab
designs.gives: STUDIES THE CEMS; OPENS THE SUPERCOMPUTER
designs.about: Two glass domes over vats of Cems, joined by copper pipes: where the next strains are grown.

designs.name: Supercomputer
designs.gives: THE FIRST THINKING MACHINE: OPENS THE NOUS CHIP
designs.about: Racks of dark composite behind steel, copper fins to cool it, and an Ember core under a quartz crown.

designs.name: Fusion Still
designs.gives: TOPS THE SHIP'S CELLS FROM THE STORE'S HYDROGEN
designs.about: A steel drum ringed in copper over a hot quartz eye, fed from the vents: it burns hydrogen into light for the ship when the star is too slow.

designs.name: Nous Chip
designs.gives: A VESSEL'S MIND: EVERY NEW VESSEL NEEDS ONE
designs.about: Quartz grown over a core of Ember, wired in copper: the mind the Replicator gives each new Vessel. You carry it.

designs.name: Sunlattice
designs.gives: LIGHTS THE WARREN WITHOUT EMBER: SUNLATTICE PANELS (SALT 2, QUARTZ 1)
designs.about: A pale gold lattice of lignin and glass grown under the star on a salt bed: it drinks the day and keeps it as a slow glow through the night.

designs.name: Cem Mind
designs.gives: A LIVING COMPUTER: LETTERS BETWEEN TWO CEM MINDS ARRIVE AT ONCE (SCUT LINK)
designs.about: A green lattice of Cem strains on copper trays under a glass hood, fed by light and salt: it brightens when it thinks.

designs.name: Cemwright
designs.gives: A GROWN COMPUTER: LEAVE IT A THREAD AT DUSK, READ THE ANSWER IN THE MORNING
designs.about: A copper-ribbed glass vat of green Cem culture on a salt foot, humming softly: a thread left in it works slowly through the night, drinking a little salt, and the bed gives a little lignin back when it is done.

designs.name: Watchglass
designs.gives: SHARES EVERY WATCH WITH THE OTHER WATCHGLASS WORLDS, AT LIGHT SPEED
designs.about: A small quartz lens on a steel mast, with a copper cord running down to its plinth: it sends each watch out and catches the others'.

designs.name: Mycelial Loom
designs.gives: A GROWN MEMORY: LEAVE WHAT YOU SAW, AND EVERY VESSEL HERE CAN READ IT
designs.about: A low dome of pale threaded stone grown from Cem and Earth fungus, with slow light moving through its walls: it hums very quietly and remembers.

designs.name: Seedarc
designs.gives: CARRIES LIVING SEED ABOARD THE SHIP TO THE NEXT WORLD'S STORE
designs.about: A sealed crate of pale shell under a sunwell glass lid, living seed glowing inside: it keeps a world's greens alive between the stars.

designs.name: Relay Cairn
designs.gives: HEARS THE NEAREST LIT CAIRN: LETTERS HOP ALONG A CHAIN OF THEM BETWEEN STARS
designs.about: A tall cairn of stacked stone wound with copper bands, a quartz crown over a small Ember core: it listens for the next cairn and passes the letters on.

designs.name: Flare Almanac
designs.gives: EVERY WATCH HERE NAMES ITS STAR'S TEMPER: A SHIP TO A RESTLESS STAR KEEPS A CELL SPARE
designs.about: A low Cem-grown table of glass leaves over a warm Ember heart: each watch kept here writes the star's temper on a leaf, and the Watchglass carries the leaves to every other Watchglass world.

designs.name: Tether Beacon
designs.gives: CHARGES A SHIP THAT LANDS BESIDE IT: A HOP TO OR FROM A TETHER COSTS A THIRD OF THE CELLS
designs.about: A short pylon of stacked stone ringed in copper, a quartz eye over a hydrogen heart that pulses a slow green: it fills a landed ship and lights the way for the next one.

designs.name: Tidewhisper
designs.gives: HEARS THE NEAREST TIDEWHISPER WORLD'S LAST WATCH AS A FAINT PULSE, FREE OF THE SHIP'S CELLS
designs.about: A shallow dish of sea-glass on a salt rim, set among wet reeds: it holds the last watch kept here and hums it out to the nearest other dish, a day slower than a letter.

designs.name: Lightbed
designs.gives: GROWS LIGNIN FROM LIGHT: A FEW BLOCKS A DAY INTO THE STORE
designs.about: A shallow salt tray on a stone foot where a Cem colony drinks the light and lays it down as lignin: pale green-gold layers, light running along their cracks at noon, dim at dusk.
